title: Hyena Cubs Are Born With Teeth, and They Use Them Within Hours

scenes.text: Hyena cubs are born with a full set of teeth.
Spotted hyena twins arrive about an hour apart, eyes already open, teeth already through the gums. Almost no other mammal is born like this.
Within hours, the first-born attacks the second. In captivity, cubs have even been seen fighting before they were fully out of the birth sac.
The fights decide who rules. The dominant cub takes the milk first, and when food is short it can take all of it.
In the Serengeti, about one litter in ten loses a cub this way. Scientists call it siblicide.
The winner grows faster and keeps the rank for life. Born with teeth, and a reason to use them.

description:
Spotted hyena cubs are born with their eyes open and their teeth already erupted, and littermates start fighting within hours of birth to settle which one gets first access to milk.
When food is scarce the dominant cub can monopolise the milk and the weaker one starves; in the Serengeti roughly one litter in ten loses a cub to this siblicide.
Which animal has the toughest start in life?

first_comment: In Ngorongoro Crater, where food is steady, researchers have never seen a hyena cub starve from sibling fights. Which animal sibling rivalry should we cover next?
